scripts.text:
[Suhnbi]
I am the Armsmith
I can refine all kinds of weapons,
armor and equipment, so let me
know what you want to refine.
scripts.translation:
[孙比]
我是武器匠，能精炼各种武器、防具和装备。
想精炼什么，告诉我吧。

scripts.text:
[Suhnbi]
I don't think I can refine any items you have...
scripts.translation:
[孙比]
你身上的物品，好像没有我能精炼的...

scripts.text:
[Suhnbi]
Go find another Blacksmith. You can't refine this thing.
scripts.translation:
[孙比]
去找别的铁匠吧，这东西没法精炼。

scripts.text:
[Suhnbi]
Hmm... someone perfected this already. I don't think I can work on it further.
scripts.translation:
[孙比]
嗯...这件装备已经精炼到极致了，我没法再加工了。

scripts.text:
[Suhnbi]
Clang! Clang! Clang!
scripts.translation:
[孙比]
Clang! Clang! Clang!

scripts.text:
[Suhnbi]
There you go! It's done.
It's been a while since I've made such a fine {0}. You must be happy because it has become stronger!
scripts.translation:
[孙比]
好了！完成了。
好久没打造过这么精美的{0}了。它变强了，你一定很高兴吧！

scripts.text:
[Suhnbi]
Uuuuuuuuuummmmmph!!!
scripts.translation:
[孙比]
Uuuuuuuuuummmmmph!!!

scripts.text:
[Suhnbi]
...
.....
.......Huhuhuhuhu~
........It was your choice and my ability, no regret.
scripts.translation:
[孙比]
...
.....
.......Huhuhuhuhu~
...这是你的选择，也是我的能力所限，别后悔。

scripts.text:
[Suhnbi]
You want to refine a level {0} weapon?
To refine that, you'll need to have one ^ff9999{1}^000000 and {2} zeny.
Would you like to continue?
scripts.translation:
[孙比]
想精炼一把{0}级武器？
需要1个^ff9999{1}^000000和{2} Zeny。
要继续吗？

scripts.text:
[Suhnbi]
To refine that, you'll need to have one ^ff9999{0}^000000 and {1} zeny.
Would you like to continue?
scripts.translation:
[孙比]
精炼需要1个^ff9999{0}^000000和{1} Zeny。
要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Suhnbi]
Wow!!
This weapon probably
looks like it's been refined...
many times...
It may break if
you refine it again.
scripts.translation:
[孙比]
哇！！这武器好像已经精炼过很多次了...
再精炼下去，可能会损坏。

scripts.text:
And if it breaks,
you can't use it anymore!
All the cards in it and the properties ^ff0000will be lost^000000!
^ff0000Besides, the equipment will break!^000000
Are you sure you still want to continue?
scripts.translation:
一旦损坏，就再也不能使用了！
镶嵌的卡片和装备属性都^ff0000会消失^000000！
^ff0000而且，装备本身也会损毁！^000000
确定还要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Suhnbi]
Good.
Because if the weapon breaks from unreasonable refining, then I get a bad mood, too.
scripts.translation:
[孙比]
这就对了。
勉强精炼把武器弄坏的话，我心里也不好受。

scripts.text:
[Suhnbi]
Giggle. Giggle. Oh, you have guts, daring to refine this.
You know it's pretty risky, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[孙比]
Giggle. Giggle. 敢精炼这件装备，胆子真不小。
你知道风险很大吧？

scripts.text:
If your defensive equipment is broken, you'll never be able to use it again.
Even your cards and your modifications will ^ff0000completely disappear^000000.
Do you really wish to continue?
scripts.translation:
防具一旦损坏，就再也不能使用了。
镶嵌的卡片和改造效果也会^ff0000彻底消失^000000。
确定还要继续吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Suhnbi]
What nonsense. You waste my precious time.
Get lost, punk.
scripts.translation:
[孙比]
真是胡闹，浪费我宝贵的时间。
滚开，臭小子。

scripts.text:
[Suhnbi]
Wait a second...
Do you think I'm stupid?!
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[孙比]
等一下...
你以为我傻吗？！
趁我不注意你换了物品！给我滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Suhnbi]
Are these all you have?
I'm very sorry, but I can't do anything without all the materials. Besides, I deserve some payments for my work, don't I?
scripts.translation:
[孙比]
就带了这些？
不好意思，材料不齐，我可没办法。
再说，干活总得收点报酬吧？

scripts.text:
[Suhnbi]
I can't help it even if you're not happy about it...
scripts.translation:
[孙比]
即使你不高兴，我也无能为力...
